name: American Ronin

tenures.role: tag team — a heel duo that also worked as "special referees" (billed simply "Ronin"), including for the 9 Feb 2003 World Tag Team Championship main event; a September 2002 champions snapshot lists them a Tag Team Championship contender under the name American Ronin

caption: Matt Register and Jeffrey Wayne, working together as American Ronin — a heel tag team who doubled as "special referees" for OSW's own World Tag Team Championship main events.

name: Civil Disobedience

tenures.role: tag team — OSW's own first Tag Team Champions, won at Crowning Glory (10 Mar 2002), lost 30 Mar 2002
tenures.source: Seth Masters's and Trevor Hawke's own roster.cgi bio cards ("OSW Tag Team Champions: March 10, 2002 to March 30, 2002"); appeared together as "Civil Disobedience" in OSW's own 9 Feb 2003 Slam! broadcast text.

tenures.note: Dated from the fed's own record of its matches (3 shows). Joined to this record on the card's own evidence: The card's finisher (The Trendsetter), Other Feds (OSW, PWA) and Other Fed Awards (2x OSW Tag Team Champions, 2002 OSW Tag Team of the Year) are this OSW unit's; the fed's write-up of Adrenaline 1 (9 November 2003) announces 'Seth Masters and Trevor Hawke, CIVIL DISOBEDIENCE' and has them back in action 'for the first time since last June'.

entrance_music.verbatim: 'Come Out and Play' by the Offspring
entrance_music.title: Come Out and Play

caption: Seth Masters and Trevor Hawke's own pairing, OSW's first Tag Team Champions, crowned at the fed's own debut PPV, Crowning Glory, and dethroned three weeks later.

identity.note: PRIME's own biography card for this team names OSW and claims two OSW Tag Team Championships; its roster is the same two men, Seth Masters and Trevor Hawke, and both records carry the entrance Cult of Personality by Living Colour.

The fed's biography card (accession 0159), bio 9450, is this record: The card's finisher (The Trendsetter), Other Feds (OSW, PWA) and Other Fed Awards (2x OSW Tag Team Champions, 2002 OSW Tag Team of the Year) are this OSW unit's; the fed's write-up of Adrenaline 1 (9 November 2003) announces 'Seth Masters and Trevor Hawke, CIVIL DISOBEDIENCE' and has them back in action 'for the first time since last June'.

name: Da Westsidaz

tenures.role: tag team — challenged for, then won, the OSW World Tag Team Championship (23 Jun - 21 Jul 2002); a September 2002 champions snapshot separately lists "Da Westsidaz" as a contender for the belts they'd have already lost by then

caption: Riptah and Short Circuit, teaming as Da Westsidaz, won the OSW World Tag Team Championship at Ascension, 23 June 2002, after two failed challenges.

identity.note: Riptah and Short Circuit are named directly, wrestling as "Da Westsidaz," in two served OSW Tag Team Championship matches (matches/messages/112.shtml, 114.shtml) -- the same pairing whose own individual bio cards separately record an OSW Tag Team Championship reign, 23 Jun - 21 Jul 2002, immediately after these matches.

PCW's own database (lot 0159) carries this team's own PCW biography card, which names OSW and claims one OSW World Tag Team Championship. Its roster is the same pairing held here, Riptah and Short Circuit, and the reign it points at is the dated OSW reign already on this record.

name: Heaven & Hell

tenures.role: tag team — OSW World Tag Team Champions, holding the belts as of 9 Feb 2003, when they retained against Politically Incorrect (PCW) in a Falls Count Anywhere match

caption: The pairing of Hessian, "the Goliath," and Propaganda, "God's Ultimatum" — an unlikely alliance between two men who'd feuded months earlier — that held the OSW World Tag Team Championship into 2003.

name: Heresian Bloodlust

tenures.role: tag team — OSW World Tag Team Champions, holding the belts from some point after 30 Mar 2002 through at least 22 Jun 2002

caption: Hessian and Azrael Cain, teaming as Heresian Bloodlust, held the OSW World Tag Team Championship through the spring and early summer of 2002.

name: The Cult

tenures.role: stable — a combination finisher billed "Cult Classic" (a stacked Boston Crab into a Butterfly Lock)

caption: Hessian and Vampir Nosferatu's own combination act on OSW's roster, billed together under a shared finishing sequence, "Cult Classic."

name: The Throwbacks

tenures.role: tag team — a three-step combination finisher, "The Double Tap" (Gibson's School's In Session into an ankle lock into the Silencer, timed with Vendetta's camel clutch into a Fujiwara armbar into Crowd Control)

caption: 'Old School' Dave Gibson and Clay Vendetta's own pairing on OSW's roster, working a three-step submission combination they billed as The Double Tap.

name: Twisted Metal

tenures.role: wrestlers — a trio of billed "Humanoid Robot" units (Gunmetal, Chico, and a third, self-destructing model), managed by a fourth robot, "Cobol"
tenures.note: Billed straight, in-storyline, as literal robots — Gunmetal's own "buggy Windows operating system" causes periodic electrical-surge "crashes" requiring a ten-minute reboot; Chico runs on hydraulics. A third, self-destructing model and a managing robot, "Cobol," round out the act.

caption: A trio of wrestlers OSW billed straight-faced as literal robots — Gunmetal, prone to Windows-style system crashes mid-match, and Chico, running on hydraulics — managed by a fourth robot, Cobol.
